_what: Brief 5 HLOD GPU-share pass. FINAL v3 2026-09-20. Verdict INCONCLUSIVE for the GPU number, but the proxy COMPOSITION and geometry are now measured (Task 2d/4c).
_verdict_reason: The HLOD proxy GPU SHARE (a millisecond number) could not be measured inside the fence. -game path: the positive control FAILED -- as-is vs `wp.Runtime.HLOD 0` runs are byte-identical on every render-side counter (GPUSceneInstanceCount, SceneCulling/NumStaticInstances, ActorCount/WorldPartitionHLOD, GPUTime), because the startup -ExecCmds one-shot fires before the far cells stream and cannot re-fire post-settle without an ini/asset/Python change (see hlod_task2_gamepath.md; wp.Runtime.HLOD is a command, HLODRuntimeSubsystem.cpp:149). editor path: at full editor residency the proxies are NOT drawn (real cells render), so the v2 actor-hide gave a null 0.015 ms delta -- that null IS the positive-control failure (audit A2), not a measured zero. Forcing proxy render needs region-unloading (high-risk, and still editor!=-game). So the exact share stays open (item-8 -game MRQ territory).

_what_IS_measured_task2d_4c._note: Even without a GPU number, the proxy composition and where it renders are now read back -- which is what the share question was really asking.

Alpine8K_HLODLayer_Instanced.meaning: replaces source meshes with ISMs at their LOWEST LOD (5.8 doc + verified). So the near-HLOD band renders each species as its lowest-LOD instance: ScotsPineTall billboard (32 tris, LOD3 ss 0.168), spruce_half imposter (6 tris, LOD4 ss 0.17), sapling lowest LOD (326 tris), and the Nanite Norway Spruce as its Nanite FALLBACK (2335 tris), NOT its full Nanite mesh.

Alpine8K_HLODLayer_Merged.meaning: a single APPROXIMATED mesh per cell (with Generate-Nanite-Enabled-Mesh option) for the far band -- NOT 'merged Nanite proxies of the trees' as v2 said. This is the parent (far) layer.

hlod_layers._caveat: cell_size/loading_range are the HLODLayer asset's own fields, DEPRECATED in 5.7 (authoritative runtime grid/loading now live in the WP partition settings). Read back for the record; do not treat as the runtime streaming ranges (recipe declares main 512 m, merged 1.024 km, instanced 2 km).

_what_IS_measured_task2d_4c.answer_512m_to_2km: Between the 512 m main streaming range and the ~2 km instanced-HLOD range, each tree is rendered as its Instanced-HLOD proxy = its LOWEST-LOD instance (billboard / imposter / lowest LOD / Nanite fallback), then beyond that as part of a single MESH_APPROXIMATE merged proxy per cell. The Nanite spruce is NOT instanced as its full Nanite mesh in the HLOD; the INSTANCING layer uses the lowest LOD (the 2335-tri fallback).
_what_IS_measured_task2d_4c._composition_implication: The far forest is cards + a 2335-tri fallback + approximate merged meshes, covering few screen pixels beyond 512 m. Cheap by construction; consistent with (but not a substitute for) a measured GPU share.

task2d_distances_fixed._what: Audit A1 fix: HLOD cell distances derived from the grid index in each actor label (centre=(idx+0.5)*cellsize, cellsize(L)=25600*2^L cm), NOT get_actor_location/bounds (degenerate for Instanced HLOD -> the identical-distance artefact). Distances now differ per station and per cell.
task2d_distances_fixed._nearest_note: Nearest CELL CENTRE (256 m cells); cells within the 512 m streaming range have their real source loaded so their proxy is hidden. RENDERED proxies begin beyond the streaming range. Per-layer-level p10/p50/p90 distributions in editor_census_v3.json hlod_cell_distance_m.
task2d_distances_fixed.artefact_refuted: The v2 'same three distances (2238.6/3500.3/2381.5) for every actor' is refuted: distances now vary across cells and stations.
